echo.description: Dev stub (npm run stub:echo). Enabled where ECHO_MCP_URL is set in .env.

mfp.description: Mason MyFitnessPal MCP (loopback, no auth). Tools are fitness_*. Enabled where MFP_MCP_URL is set in .env (server Mac: http://127.0.0.1:8484/mcp).

finance.description: finance-app /mcp (Vercel, stateless Streamable HTTP). Enabled per machine by FINANCE_MCP_URL + FINANCE_MCP_TOKEN in .env; unset = skipped. FINANCE_MCP_BYPASS only for preview deployments.

cines.description: cines-mx-mcp (Cinépolis listings, showtimes, seat maps; holds and purchases are approval-gated by the hub). Loopback, no auth. Enabled where CINES_MCP_URL is set in .env (server Mac: http://127.0.0.1:8686/mcp).
